prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one production 2-by-2 square sprite sheet for an educational pet-growth app. Input image is a STYLE AND COAT-IDENTITY reference, not an age-accurate template. Create FOUR DISTINCT biologically age-appropriate full-body illustrations of the SAME rabbit: A warm tan rabbit with cream muzzle and chest, brown eyes and pink inner ears. Top-left BABY: very young fuzzy kit with short soft ears, round face, tiny compact torso, tucked paws. Top-right GROWING: older kit with ears beginning to lengthen, less round face and more active posture. Bottom-left YOUNG: juvenile rabbit with longer upright ears, lengthening torso and hind legs, slimmer youthful face. Bottom-right ADULT: mature rabbit, fully elongated upright ears, anatomically longer back and strong adult haunches, head noticeably smaller relative to body. Use natural rabbit forepaws resting down, no human hands. Composition: exactly four equal square cells in a seamless 2-column by 2-row square grid; baby top-left, growing top-right, young bottom-left, adult bottom-right. Each animal centered within its own quadrant, paws grounded near the same cell baseline, complete ears/paws/tail visible, generous empty padding on every edge so no part crosses a cell boundary. Match the friendly clean outlined softly shaded children's illustration style of the reference, but adult proportions must be visibly mature and not baby-like. Each stage has a distinct anatomy, face and body proportions, not just a resized duplicate. Actual transparent background across the whole sheet including the margins between the four animals. No white rectangles, no checkerboard painted into image, no text, labels, numbers, dividers, props, clothes, logos or watermarks. Keep every cell exactly equal and all four animals fully isolated for use as a 2x2 CSS sprite.
